findings.description: Explicit --agents-yaml overrides everything, checkout-local agents.yaml beneath reviewed --cwd precedes coordinator and global state, and missing-local config falls back to coordinator before disk. Verified in _orchestrator_for_dispatch (review_dispatcher.py:2575-2591) and tested with exact reviewed cwd assertion and full precedence coverage in test_review_dispatcher.py:1783-1853.
findings.resolution: Accept config precedence resolver and regression suite.

findings.description: Vendor availability probe (--check-vendors) and agent listing (--list-agents) share the exact same _orchestrator_for_dispatch resolver and reviewed --cwd as review dispatch. A live check reports all 5 configured vendors available (5/2 available). Verified in review_dispatcher.py:2520-2545, 2665-2679 and test_check_vendors.py:103-116.
findings.resolution: Accept shared resolver routing across all CLI entry points.

findings.description: Antigravity structured review command pairs --output-format json before --json-schema and delivers prompt via --prompt. Review dispatcher _extract_findings correctly unwraps structuredOutput, structured_output, and JSON-string response envelopes. Verified in agent-coordinator/agents.yaml:254-284, review_dispatcher.py:869-893, and test_review_dispatcher.py:1855-1899.
findings.resolution: Accept Antigravity command flags and envelope extraction.

findings.description: Migration 038 preserves legacy non-projection submit and reconcile semantics: when p_projection_labels is NULL and projection tuple is absent, tasks are inserted directly without projection head checks or label mutation. Verified in 038_atomic_projection_labels.sql:25-56 and live postgres test test_unlabelled_legacy_issue_collision_keeps_pre039_dedupe_semantics.
findings.resolution: Accept legacy submit and reconcile preservation.

findings.description: Migration 039 establishes work_queue_projection_ownership as sole database-backed authority. Unowned rows fail closed without auto-adopting mutable fields, preventing ordinary tasks from being commandeered even if payload or labels are spoofed. Verified in 039_projection_integrity_and_insert_events.sql:5-18, 100-113, 207-220 and test_owned_projection_cannot_take_over_unowned_issue_key.

Labelled collisions on unowned or non-issue tasks fail closed with projection_key_collision mapped to HTTP 409 Conflict prior to any transaction mutation or head advancement. Verified in 039_projection_integrity_and_insert_events.sql:108-112, 215-219 and coordination_api.py:1420-1445.
findings.resolution: Accept fail-closed projection key collision handling.

findings.description: Legacy unlabelled reconcile where p_projection_labels IS NULL retains backward compatibility by cancelling stale active rows based on tuple inequality without requiring registry ownership or modifying labels. Verified in 039_projection_integrity_and_insert_events.sql:240-244 and work_queue.py:405-440.

Concurrent generations for the same change serialize cleanly via pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(v_change, 0)) acquired at transaction start in both submit_task and reconcile_work_projection. Verified in 039_projection_integrity_and_insert_events.sql:72-80, 166-174.
findings.resolution: Accept advisory transaction locking for generation serialization.

findings.description: Every ESCALATE transition durably records previous_phase, escalation_reason, phase_started_at, and increments total_iterations once. Re-entering ESCALATE is retry-idempotent and preserves the original incident metadata. DONE is strictly terminal in transition and escalate commands. Verified in autopilot.py:514-534 and runner.py:425-427, 492-494.
findings.resolution: Accept durable escalation recording, idempotence, and terminal guards.

findings.description: Console-approved and automatic escalate_resume share one canonical persisted edge ('resolved' -> previous_phase). Escalate-resume parking persists the resolved edge before host projection. Verified in autopilot.py:1867-1885 and runner.py:185-198.
findings.resolution: Accept shared resolved edge persistence across approval modes.

findings.description: Failed apply-outcome retains the un-applied handoff file, logs the failure, and transitions to ESCALATE with previous_phase derived from the authoritative durable loop state rather than caller state. Verified in autopilot.py:685-705 and test_apply_outcome_contract.py.
findings.resolution: Accept authoritative durable phase recovery on apply-outcome failure.

findings.description: Coordinator-free execution tiers remain completely isolated: autopilot.py and runner.py do not eagerly import queue_projection, and coordinator-free runs cannot invoke coordination bridge transport. Verified in test_phase_projection_isolation.py:12-86 and SKILL.md:30-45.
findings.resolution: Accept coordinator-free tier isolation and lazy import boundaries.

findings.description: Projection SSE visibility is current-only: projection.labels_changed event bursts coalesce into a single snapshot rebuild using label-filtered list_issues, which excludes cancelled rows from the board view. Verified in event_stream.py:272-282, 320-329.
findings.resolution: Accept current-only SSE projection coalescing and exclusion.

findings.description: OpenAPI 3.1 specification for work-queue matches runtime constraints: ProjectionKey defines exact regex, enum, and integer ranges; projection_labels specifies ordered heterogeneous prefixItems with 2 items bounds; Problem details schema aligns with RFC 7807. Verified in openspec/contracts/agent-coordinator/openapi/work-queue.yaml:90-180, 220-280.
findings.resolution: Accept OpenAPI 3.1 schema alignment with runtime constraints.

findings.description: install.sh --check performs byte-level diff comparisons across skills, shared libraries, and install-manifest across runtime mirrors. Verified in install.sh:237-306 and test_consumer_portability.py:90-127 (11/11 tests passed).

Architecture artifacts declare explicit provenance with pinned source_revision, restricted input roots, and fingerprint-based freshness; post-revision skills-only dispatcher updates remain outside coordinator input roots and do not cause freshness divergence. Verified in docs/architecture-analysis/architecture.provenance.json:1-80.
findings.resolution: Accept architecture provenance and freshness contract.
